Optimization: Build-time versus per-token cost. The modes preserve the supported grammar language.
Optimization.FAST_RUNTIME: Favor lower masking latency, accepting more compilation work.
BoundaryTriggerDetail: Optional metadata for composition boundaries, independent of the masking optimization. A request at final link overrides the prepared request.
BoundaryTriggerDetail.TOKENS: Build a conservative, parser-state-independent token candidate set.
BoundaryTriggerDetail.EXACT: Build parser-state-sensitive boundary metadata where supported.
Token: An original token ID with no vocabulary identity. Only ID membership is checked against the target vocabulary; the same ID can refer to different bytes. Use `vocab.tokens([id])` for a vocabulary-bound singleton.
ExactTokens: One token event chosen from a vocabulary-bound set. Vocabularies must have the same ID-to-byte mapping and exact-only IDs, even for a singleton. An empty set matches nothing.
ExactTokens.ids: Sorted IDs, materialized on access. Prefer `ranges` for large sets.
ExactTokens.ranges: Normalized, disjoint Python ranges with exclusive stops; does not expand the IDs.
ExactTokens.__len__: Number of IDs, rather than ranges.
Vocab: Original model IDs mapped to exact token bytes. IDs may be sparse; masks keep their original positions. Reuse one vocabulary across components to share compilation caches.
Vocab.from_dict: String keys are UTF-8 encoded; byte keys are used verbatim. IDs must fit an unsigned 32-bit integer.
Vocab.from_id_to_bytes: Use the tokenizer’s exact decoded bytes, including partial UTF-8 sequences, rather than display spellings.
Vocab.from_llama_cpp: Extract the byte vocabulary from a llama-cpp-python `Llama`. EOG, control, unused and empty-piece tokens are omitted from byte matching; use `llama_cpp_end_token_ids` for the root stopping policy.
Vocab.llama_cpp_end_token_ids: EOG IDs discovered by `from_llama_cpp`; pass them as `end_tokens` when compiling or linking.
Vocab.tokens: Match one of the supplied IDs. Unknown or duplicate IDs are errors; empty input matches nothing. The result retains vocabulary identity, including for a singleton. Contiguous ranges remain compact; other iterables are consumed once.
Vocab.token_ranges: Union of nonempty Python ranges with step 1 or -1 and exclusive stops. Overlapping or adjacent ranges merge; unknown IDs are errors. Empty input matches nothing. Use `tokens` for arbitrary strides.
Vocab.__len__: Counts byte-backed entries; exact-only control IDs are excluded.
Grammar: Reusable source grammar with mutable bindings. `bind` changes this handle; clones and already attached children keep independent snapshots. Parsing and vocabulary checks can be deferred until preparation or compilation.
Grammar.from_ebnf: Parsing and compilation errors can be deferred until `prepare` or `compile`.
Grammar.from_glrm: GLRM supports typed external slots; fill them with `bind` before compiling a runnable root.
Grammar.from_json_schema: Accepts JSON text or a JSON-serializable object. The importer implements a subset of JSON Schema: unsupported assertions may be silently weakened. Validate generated values separately when full schema conformance matters.
Grammar.from_lark: The default `recognition` profile and the `llm` extension profile differ in accepted syntax. Named token atoms require explicit `token_names` mappings; they are never inferred from tokenizer spellings.
Grammar.exact: Adapt one vocabulary-bound token event to a grammar fragment. Adds no byte spelling, ignore rule or root end-token policy.
Grammar.requirements: Includes unresolved slots in attached open children. Diagnostic expansion is bounded and may raise an error for very large shared graphs.
Grammar.bind: Fill a declared slot once. Use `::` for nested paths, after attaching the parent. Token slots require `Token` or `ExactTokens`. Attached children are snapshots; failed binds leave this handle unchanged.
Grammar.clone: Independent binding snapshot; later binds on either handle do not affect the other.
Grammar.__deepcopy__: Equivalent to `clone`; immutable compiled storage may remain shared.
Grammar.prepare: Legacy compatibility method producing PreparedGrammar. For new reusable graphs, create Module(self) and call its precompile(vocab) operation.
Grammar.compile: Requires every slot to be bound. `end_tokens` are root generation controls, allowed only at acceptance; commit the selected end token before stopping. Their policy is not inherited by an embedded child. `optimization` defaults to `AUTO`.
PreparedGrammar: Legacy preparation-stage compatibility API. New reusable graphs should use Module, which supports cold and precompiled children without a separate public preparation phase.
PreparedGrammar.requirements: Unresolved paths, including slots inside attached children. Diagnostic expansion is bounded.
PreparedGrammar.bind: Fill a declared slot once. Attach a parent before binding its descendants. Prepared children must use the same byte mapping and exact-only IDs. Attached children are snapshots; failed binds leave this handle unchanged.
PreparedGrammar.clone: Independent binding snapshot sharing immutable compiled machinery.
PreparedGrammar.__deepcopy__: Equivalent to `clone`; immutable compiled storage may remain shared.
PreparedGrammar.link: Requires all slots to be bound. Selects final optimization and root end tokens; an explicit boundary request overrides the prepared request. End tokens become allowed only at acceptance and must be committed before stopping.
PreparedGrammar.save: Preserves compiled machinery, vocabulary and unresolved slots. Shared definitions are serialized once.
PreparedGrammar.load: Rejects malformed or incompatible artifacts. An optional vocabulary must match the saved token-ID/byte mapping and lets the loaded graph share its caches.
Constraint: Immutable runnable grammar and root stopping policy. Reuse across sequences; each `start` creates independent mutable state.
Constraint.marker_ids: Sorted, distinct application marker IDs, independent of model token IDs.
Constraint.mask_len: Packed 32-bit word count for `fill_mask`, not the Boolean-array length returned by `mask`.
Constraint.save: Embeds the vocabulary by default. With `external_vocab=True`, loading requires the exact original token-ID/byte mapping, not merely the same vocabulary size.
Constraint.load: Rejects malformed or incompatible artifacts. Supply `vocab` for external-vocabulary artifacts; it must match the original mapping.
ConstraintState: Mutable state for one generated sequence.
ConstraintState.clone: Independent snapshot at the current prefix.
ConstraintState.mask: New Boolean array indexed by original token ID. `size` must cover the constraint’s entire ID range; extra positions are false. Includes the root end-token policy.
ConstraintState.fill_mask: Fill a contiguous, writable 1-D NumPy `int32` array with at least `Constraint.mask_len()` words. Bit `id % 32` of word `id // 32` represents that original ID. Extra words are zeroed. Signed words retain all 32 mask bits.
ConstraintState.commit_token: Unknown IDs raise an error. Forbidden IDs reject the state and may also raise an error; subsequent masks are zero. An allowed end token terminates the sequence; later commits raise an error.
ConstraintState.commit_bytes: Advance by raw bytes rather than model token events. This does not substitute for committing exact-token or end-token events.
ConstraintState.is_accepting: The current prefix is a complete grammar match; further tokens may still be allowed. This alone does not commit an end token.
ConstraintState.is_rejected: The prefix cannot be extended to a valid match.
ConstraintState.forced_tokens: Read-only library-canonical prefix of genuinely forced text. Uses longest admitted nonempty spelling and the lowest original-ID alias; exact events retain their IDs. Stops at root acceptance, unstable tokenization, intermediate exact-event opportunities, or proof limits. May construct full masks; typed resource failures raise errors.
ConstraintState.marker_events: Initial or most recent commit’s `(marker_id, absolute_byte_offset)` batch, sorted by offset then ID, with duplicate pairs removed. These are possible observations, not captures or promises about the final parse. A failed commit clears the batch; mask and forcing queries leave it unchanged.
auto: Adaptive JSON Schema policy inspection and persisted tier selection. For ordinary compilation, prefer `Grammar.compile(..., optimization=Optimization.AUTO)`. Policy thresholds are empirical choices, not latency guarantees. All tiers inherit the JSON Schema importer’s partial assertion support.
auto.AutoSchemaShape: Source-shape counts used by the policy, not a schema validation result. `json_bytes` measures normalized JSON serialized with sorted keys and compact separators.
auto.json_schema_auto_shape: Extract the policy’s source-shape features from JSON text or a JSON-serializable schema.
auto.select_json_schema_auto_tier: Select `o1`, `o2` or `o3` using fitted source-shape thresholds. The choice predicts a compilation/masking trade-off; it does not guarantee a latency bound.
auto.AutoConstraint: Constraint wrapper that records the selected tier and policy. Its artifact carries the tier so loading does not rerun selection. JSON Schema assertions unsupported by the importer may remain unenforced.
auto.AutoConstraint.__init__: Use `from_json_schema` for normal construction; unknown tier names raise `ValueError`.
auto.AutoConstraint.from_json_schema: Choose a tier and compile. Accepts schema text or an object; inherits the importer’s partial JSON Schema support.
auto.AutoConstraint.load: Restore the recorded tier. Rejects missing or unknown artifact tags; the supplied vocabulary must match the original.
auto.AutoConstraint.save: Includes the tier tag and underlying constraint artifact.
auto.AutoConstraint.start: Independent decoding state with the same mask/commit interface as `ConstraintState`.
auto.AutoConstraint.mask_len: Packed 32-bit word count for a mask buffer.
UnboundExtern: An external declaration with a qualified occurrence path, declared kind and original source coordinates. Module.unbound contains unresolved declarations; Module.externs also includes bound declarations.
ModuleOptions: Immutable local compilation settings owned by a Module, never by its source Grammar. Independently configured children keep their own settings.
ModuleOptions.__init__: Use AUTO and NONE when omitted. This creates an options value only; it performs no grammar compilation.
ModuleOptions.optimization: Local compilation objective. Unsupported combinations with retained child representations fail explicitly rather than silently changing modes.
ModuleOptions.boundary_trigger: Local boundary-metadata request. The NONE default builds no such metadata.
CompileOptions: Immutable final root settings. Pass this to Module.compile(options=...) or use its end_tokens keyword, but not both.
CompileOptions.__init__: Root end-token controls apply only at acceptance and are not inherited by children.
CompileOptions.end_tokens: Original token IDs allowed as root stopping controls at acceptance.
Expr: Immutable scope-preserving union or concatenation of whole grammar/module snapshots. Grouping operators add neither lexical scopes nor public path segments.
Expr.choice: Unordered context-free union, not prioritized choice. Each Grammar or Module leaf retains its own scope. Empty choice is rejected when materializing the expression.
Expr.sequence: Language concatenation, including model tokens crossing leaf boundaries. Empty sequence denotes epsilon. Configured leaves retain their settings and work.
Module: An owned, independently configured reusable grammar with snapshot-safe mutable bindings and optional retained compilation work. It may remain open or contain raw and precompiled children.
Module.__init__: Create a cold module from Grammar or Expr, without compilation or vocabulary. Supply either an options value or local keyword settings. Configured expression leaves keep their own settings.
Module.options: Immutable snapshot of this module owner's local options; it does not combine child options.
Module.with_options: Return a configured snapshot without changing the original. An options object replaces local settings; keywords alone update selected fields. Do not combine both forms. Incompatible locally retained work rejects the change.
Module.set_options: Update local options atomically and return None. An options object replaces the settings; keywords alone update selected fields. Incompatible retained local work rejects the change without altering bindings or children.
Module.bind: Fill one declared or qualified extern atomically. Capture a child snapshot, including open descendants, options and retained work; never compile during binding. Unknown, duplicate, wrong-kind or target-conflicting inputs fail without partial mutation.
Module.precompile: Perform and retain currently possible definition-local work for this vocabulary even while externs are open. Mutates this handle and returns None; existing clones are unchanged. Work is shared across equivalent definitions and uses the caller's bounded compilation context.
Module.compile: Create a runnable constraint, completing outstanding work while reusing compatible retained work. Requires all externs resolved and matching vocabulary. Supply either CompileOptions or end_tokens, not both; local settings are not overridden here.
Module.unbound: Read-only list of unresolved external declarations, with qualified occurrence paths and available source spans.
Module.externs: Read-only list of all external declarations, including bound slots and declarations in attached child occurrences.
Module.clone: Return an independent snapshot sharing immutable source and retained work. Later edits to either handle do not change the other.
Module.__copy__: Return a cheap independent snapshot; bindings and options edits do not affect previously captured values.
Module.__deepcopy__: Return a logically independent snapshot while sharing immutable native data; retain Python deepcopy memo semantics.
Module.save: Serialize source, options, open bindings, target commitments and retained work without compilation. The result may still have unresolved externs.
Module.load: Load a validated cold, open or work-bearing module without compilation. If supplied, the vocabulary must match stored original-ID mappings and exact-only tokens.
Grammar.from_expr: Construct source grammar from an expression containing source-only leaves. Reject configured or precompiled Module leaves instead of discarding settings or retained work.
Grammar.module: Create a cold default-configured Module snapshot without compilation. Settings belong only to the returned Module.
Grammar.unbound: Read-only unresolved external declaration paths in this source grammar and attached source snapshots.
Grammar.externs: Read-only all external declarations, including resolved slots and independently attached source occurrences.
UnboundExtern.name: Qualified path joined with `::`.
UnboundExtern.path: Path segments from the assembly root to the unresolved slot.
UnboundExtern.kind: A token slot accepts exact events; a grammar slot also accepts a grammar component.
UnboundExtern.source_span: `(start_byte, end_byte, line, column)` in the declaring source, or `None`. The byte interval is half-open; line and Unicode-scalar column are one-based.
